SELECT generic_name, package_ndc, presentation, company_name, availability, shortage_reason, update_date, related_info, related_info_link,
  CASE WHEN package_ndc = '55150-438-10' THEN 'same_package'
       WHEN package_ndc LIKE '55150-438-%' THEN 'same_product'
       WHEN lower(company_name) LIKE 'eugia%' THEN 'same_maker'
       ELSE 'same_ingredient' END AS match
FROM fda_files.shorta
